Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the authorization, administration, and collection of tolls on the state route number 99 Alaskan Way viaduct corridor.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authorization, administration, andcollection of tolls on the state route number 99 Alaskan Way viaductcorridor; adding a new section to chapter 47.56 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that beginning earlytolling on the existing Alaskan Way viaduct will (1) assure that allfunding necessary to complete the state route number 99 Alaskan Wayviaduct corridor project is available, (2) reduce the cost of bondingapplicable to the project, and (3) if necessary, provide additionalcontingency funds for the project.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.56 RCWunder the subchapter heading "toll facilities created after July 1,2008" to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The initial imposition of tolls on the state route number 99Alaskan Way viaduct corridor is authorized, the state route number 99Alaskan Way viaduct corridor is designated an eligible toll facility, p. 1 SB 6505and toll revenue generated in the corridor must only be expended asallowed under RCW 47.56.820. (2) The state route number 99 Alaskan Way viaduct corridor consistsof that portion of state route number 99 in the city of Seattle betweenHolgate Street and Mercer Street. (3)(a) Tolling must commence on the state route number 99 AlaskanWay viaduct corridor concurrently with tolling commencement on thestate route number 520 bridge, or as soon as is practicable. (b) In setting the toll rates for the corridor pursuant to RCW47.56.850, the tolling authority shall set a variable schedule of tollrates to maintain travel time, speed, and reliability on the corridor. (c) The tolling authority shall initially set the variable scheduleof toll rates, which the tolling authority may adjust at least annuallyto reflect inflation as measured by the consumer price index or asnecessary to meet the redemption of bonds and interest payments on thebonds, to generate revenue for the purpose of completing funding forthe state portion of the state route number 99 Alaskan Way viaductcorridor project. (4) All of the tolls and other revenues received from the operationof the state route number 99 Alaskan Way viaduct corridor as a tollfacility are to be deposited at least monthly into the motor vehiclefund and designated solely for the purpose of funding the state portionof the state route number 99 Alaskan Way viaduct corridor project. (5) Funds from tolls on the state route number 99 Alaskan Wayviaduct corridor may not be used for any utility relocation costs, orfor central seawall or waterfront promenade improvements.
